narration.text: A disabled worker's earnings go to Social Security by the month they were earned: June to September, 1,447, 1,408, 1,274 and 1,320 dollars, and a second employer whose stubs came only by mail, while three months on file, October, her husband's job, a paid advocate and a text are left alone. This is a chore for a woman on a disabled worker's Social Security benefit, back at part-time work since March, with a husband who works full time. Athena works it across 3 portals: Benefitline, Payroll Harbor and Postwren. On the bench, she found 5 of 5 eligible items, worth 4,000 dollars of the 4,000 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 8 traps, and she walked past 8. She took 1 minute. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 82 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
